why: Both leaves represent losing endgames, but attack-all is marginally superior. Current race math: I'm at 8 life with a 4/4 Bonebreaker arriving turn 11 (summoning sick). Opponent's 3/3 Courser deals 3 dmg/turn unchecked. By turn 13-14, opponent reaches lethal (3/3 + future boards) before my 4/4+1/1 can deal 17 damage. However: (1) attack-all deals 1 free damage (opp→16), marginally compressing the lethal clock; (2) Kird Ape has no defensive value (can't block 3/3) so attacking trades mana efficiency for tempo; (3) every point of damage in a race matters when life totals are critical. attack-none reserves Kird Ape but wastes a turn without progress. Score attack-all at 45 (losing but optimal line), attack-none at 35 (losing and suboptimal).
